criterion_fired: Criterion 2 (Carry-forward Consistency), Criterion 3 (Evidence Quality), Criterion 4 (Actionable Next Steps), Criterion 5 (No Unsupported Claims)
suggested_change: Criterion 2: Require explicit statement of 'No new evidence in [call date]—revising based on [prior calls]' only if score drops >3 points; below that, treat as normal recalibration. Criterion 3: Define score bands by named contacts (1–2: zero contacts, 3–4: unnamed authority signals, 5+: named partial authority). Criterion 4: Validate next step target role matches or exceeds current score; flag if asking non-champion to champion. Criterion 5: Require score to reflect actual formalization level (1–3: stated only, 4–6: partially formalized, 7–10: documented/formal).
